name: @mercatus-liber/fulfillment
description: Per-order-line fulfillment routing and status (subsystem 41). Depends on @mercatus-liber/core only; reads orders via a narrow structural interface (OrderLookup), never importing @mercatus-liber/checkout-orders directly. Owns a FulfillmentRoutingRepository (skuId -> provider-key mapping, defaulting every SKU to 'manual') and the FulfillmentAdapter contract every real provider adapter implements, mirroring @mercatus-liber/payments' PaymentAdapter shape. Ships createManualFulfillmentAdapter() as the zero-infra default -- models today's implicit reality (an operator fulfills by hand) and the permanent fallback for self-fulfilled SKUs even once a real dropship/POD adapter exists.
